profiles.description: $GBPAD is the token of GooBooPad, an independent launchpad interface on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663) where anyone can create a coin paired with ETH, USDG, tokenized stocks and ETFs, or a community coin.

Robinhood has just released thier own AI Agent for trading,

Every single person is speaking about it now, but there is no coin for it yet?

The AI Agent is called 'Cortex' 

Massive companies have been posting about it and it's Robinhood's biggest invension since the start of the company

Luxera is a non-custodial onchain draw protocol on Robinhood Chain.

Each draw lives in its own smart contract. Rules, entries, results, claims, and refunds are all onchain -  so every stage can be verified, from join to settlement.

No hidden server deciding the outcome. The contract is the draw.

Built so a draw is readable, settleable, and checkable onchain.
goo dog is a good doggoo

boosts.description:
Robin Pepe ($ROBINPEPE) is a meme coin on Robinhood Chain. Pepe, dressed as Robin Hood, on Robinhood Chain.

It is the Pepe you already know, in a Lincoln green cap with one red feather, a longbow and three arrows. He looks about as pleased with the outfit as you would expect.

OffYield Neobank
The first neobank on Robinhood where your yield pays the bills, not you.
Deadbeef brings raw hacker energy, meme chaos, and unstoppable RobinHood vibes into one legendary coin.

Baby Bundle Cat carries the Bundle Cat legacy into a new chapter. It comes with an automatic burn mechanism designed to reduce the supply over time, while holders can receive $BUN token rewards just for being part of the community.
Update on Commander Vrax: he's a cat now 🐱

Bucket Shop: hold it, own it, get paid your way.
A 3% fee on every BUCKET trade buys real tokenized stocks and crypto and delivers them straight to holder wallets, automatically. No staking, no claiming, no wrapper. Pick a preset Bucket (Core, Tech, Chips, Markets, Crypto, Degen) or name any 1 to 20 assets yourself. Payouts clear at a $2 floor, so small holders get paid too.
Over $113,000 delivered across 50,000+ on-chain payouts since 7 August 2026. 2,500 holders. The launchpad, Buckethead cards and Stockback all run on the same engine. Launchpad contracts under audit by SB Security. Operated by Bucket Labs LLC.
